{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PDFGen.Config where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.IORef
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Control.Monad (forM_, when)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

-- | Global configuration registry for PDF generation
type ConfigRegistry = Map Text ConfigValue

data ConfigValue
  = CStr Text
  | CInt Int
  | CBool Bool
  | CMap (Map Text ConfigValue)
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- | Default PDF configuration prototype chain
data ConfigProto = ConfigProto
  { protoName   :: Text
  , protoParent :: Maybe ConfigProto
  , protoFields :: IORef ConfigRegistry
  }

-- | Resolve a field by walking the prototype chain
resolveField :: ConfigProto -> Text -> IO (Maybe ConfigValue)
resolveField proto field = do
  fields <- readIORef (protoFields proto)
  case Map.lookup field fields of
    Just val -> return (Just val)
    Nothing  -> case protoParent proto of
      Just parent -> resolveField parent field
      Nothing     -> return Nothing

-- | Set a field on a prototype, supporting dotted paths
-- e.g., "margins.top" sets nested field
setField :: ConfigProto -> Text -> ConfigValue -> IO ()
setField proto path value = do
  let segments = T.splitOn "." path
  case segments of
    []    -> return ()
    [key] -> modifyIORef' (protoFields proto) (Map.insert key value)
    (key:rest) -> do
      fields <- readIORef (protoFields proto)
      let nested = case Map.lookup key fields of
            Just (CMap m) -> m
            _             -> Map.empty
      let updated = setNested rest value nested
      modifyIORef' (protoFields proto) (Map.insert key (CMap updated))

setNested :: [Text] -> ConfigValue -> Map Text ConfigValue -> Map Text ConfigValue
setNested []     _   m = m
setNested [k]    val m = Map.insert k val m
setNested (k:ks) val m =
  let sub = case Map.lookup k m of
        Just (CMap sm) -> sm
        _              -> Map.empty
  in Map.insert k (CMap (setNested ks val sub)) m

-- | Allowed configuration paths that can be overridden
allowedPaths :: [Text]
allowedPaths =
  [ "font.size"
  , "font.family"
  , "margins.top"
  , "margins.bottom"
  , "margins.left"
  , "margins.right"
  ]

-- | Check if a config path is in the allowlist
isAllowedPath :: Text -> Bool
isAllowedPath path = path `elem` allowedPaths

-- | Create the base prototype with secure defaults
mkBaseProto :: IO ConfigProto
mkBaseProto = do
  ref <- newIORef $ Map.fromList
    [ ("font.family", CStr "Helvetica")
    , ("font.size", CInt 12)
    , ("margins", CMap $ Map.fromList
        [ ("top", CInt 72)
        , ("bottom", CInt 72)
        , ("left", CInt 54)
        , ("right", CInt 54)
        ])
    , ("permissions", CMap $ Map.fromList
        [ ("allowPrint", CBool True)
        , ("allowCopy", CBool False)
        , ("allowModify", CBool False)
        ])
    , ("encryption", CMap $ Map.fromList
        [ ("enabled", CBool True)
        , ("keyLength", CInt 256)
        ])
    ]
  return $ ConfigProto "base" Nothing ref

-- | Load environment overrides into a child prototype
-- Environment variables prefixed with PDFGEN_ are loaded
-- Only allowlisted paths can be overridden
loadEnvOverrides :: ConfigProto -> IO ConfigProto
loadEnvOverrides parent = do
  childRef <- newIORef Map.empty
  let child = ConfigProto "env_override" (Just parent) childRef
  envVars <- getEnvPairs
  forM_ envVars $ \(key, val) ->
    when ("PDFGEN_" `isPrefixOf` key) $ do
      let configPath = envKeyToPath (drop 7 key)
      when (isAllowedPath configPath) $ do
        let configVal = parseConfigValue val
        setField child configPath configVal
  return child

-- | Convert environment key format to config path
-- Underscores become dots, double underscore becomes literal underscore
envKeyToPath :: String -> Text
envKeyToPath = T.pack . go
  where
    go [] = []
    go ('_':'_':rest) = '_' : go rest
    go ('_':rest)     = '.' : go rest
    go (c:rest)       = c : go rest

-- | Parse an environment string into a ConfigValue.
-- Uses a total parser (readMaybe) to avoid runtime exceptions on
-- malformed integer-like input such as "", "-", or "--5".
parseConfigValue :: String -> ConfigValue
parseConfigValue s
  | s == "true"  = CBool True
  | s == "false" = CBool False
  | otherwise    = case (readMaybe s :: Maybe Int) of
      Just n  -> CInt n
      Nothing -> CStr (T.pack s)

-- | Simulate getting environment pairs (in real code, uses System.Environment)
getEnvPairs :: IO [(String, String)]
getEnvPairs = do
  -- In production this reads all env vars
  -- For demonstration, we check specific known override vars
  let knownKeys = [ "PDFGEN_font_size"
                  , "PDFGEN_margins_top"
                  ]
  pairs <- mapM (\k -> do
    mv <- lookupEnv k
    return $ fmap (\v -> (k, v)) mv) knownKeys
  return $ concatMap (maybe [] (:[])) pairs

-- | Generate PDF with resolved configuration
generatePDF :: ConfigProto -> Text -> IO Text
generatePDF config content = do
  encEnabled <- resolveField config "encryption.enabled"
  permsModify <- resolveField config "permissions.allowModify"
  let encrypted = case encEnabled of
        Just (CBool True) -> True
        _                 -> False
  let modifiable = case permsModify of
        Just (CBool True) -> True
        _                 -> False
  return $ T.concat
    [ "[PDF: encrypted=", T.pack (show encrypted)
    , ", modifiable=", T.pack (show modifiable)
    , ", content=", content, "]"
    ]

-- | Main entry point for PDF generation
runPDFGen :: Text -> IO Text
runPDFGen content = do
  base <- mkBaseProto
  config <- loadEnvOverrides base
  generatePDF config content
